items: Fix: pack opening stuck after the pack pops, and cards not clickable under Market → Sell. Cause: after an update your browser kept old game files for up to 4 hours. Every update now forces fresh files
Performance logging on the server to track down the reported lags
🎨 All cosmetics cost twice as much (rarities stay the same)
Arena cases: Mage case removed. Elite case is now 'Elite case General' (everything can drop), new 'Elite case Weapons' and 'Elite case Armor' (armor + backpacks) – 10k each
New Elite+ versions of all three for 50k: better odds, a quarter of the way to the Sovereign case
Kekémon: packs you cannot afford now say how many coins you are missing
Market: clear hint when you have no cards to sell yet
🏛️ New world: Market – next to Snake, Arena and Kekémon

Auction Hall: sell arena items, Kekémon cards and bought cosmetics – as Buy it now or as an auction (optional buy-out, 1–48 h). Bids are held right away and come back if you get outbid; a bid in the last minute extends the auction. 5 % fee for the seller

Lobby: walk around a plaza with fountain, lanterns and the Auction Hall – no fighting. Press F next to a player to trade, F at a stall to jump to Kekémon, Arena, Cosmetics or the Casino. Chat shows as speech bubbles
Trading moved from the arena to the market and now works with items, cards, cosmetics, scrap and coins. Requests pop up wherever you are
💖 New Waifu Booster: only female characters from anime and comics
Arena: drag an item out of the raid inventory to drop it on the ground (equipped gear too)
When the server updates, the page now reconnects by itself instead of sitting there dead
🃏 Kekémon collections were reset once (new prices and odds) – everyone got the coins back they spent on packs
Packs cost 10,000 (Anime, Heroes & Series) and 50,000 (Kek Mega, 8 cards, 3 guaranteed Rare+). Secret Rares are now truly rare: about 1 in 263 packs
New variants on every card: Pokéball (rare), Masterball (very rare) and ✦ Shiny (extremely rare). SUPER MEGA = Secret Rare + Masterball + Shiny
Drop chance table in the pack shop
New pack opening: the cards fan out face down, get shuffled into a deck, the deck flips – then swipe card by card, the best one comes last
Attacks now fit the character: signature moves for the famous ones (Kamehameha, Hollow Purple, Web Shot, I Am the One Who Knocks …), series moves for everyone else
Card art is zoomed out – you see the whole picture
Duplicates sell for more; Pokéball ×3, Masterball ×20, Shiny ×25
🃏 Kekémon is here: trading cards of 2000 anime, comic/film and series characters – each with type, HP, two attacks with energy costs, weakness and rarity
Open packs for coins (Anime, Heroes & Series, Kek Mega), flip the cards one by one – the last card is always Rare or better, Epic and up shine holo
Collection with filters, search and progress per set; duplicates sell for coins
Battles against AI gyms (5.1) and PvP duels + card trading (5.2) are next
In game list now also shows who is in Slots, Casino tables, Arena raids, PvP, Zombies or Kekémon
Chat: smaller titles (🏷️ hides them), @name pings with highlight and a soft sound (🔔 toggles it), Tab completes names
Mystery boxes in Snake can now contain coins: mostly 10–100, rarely up to 10,000
🤏 Heist from mystery boxes now steals 10% of everyone's length instead of a flat 3 (Star protects)
🏆 Achievements show how many percent of all players have them, like on Steam
Zombie perks renamed: Juggernaut, Rapid Fire, Stamina, Regeneration
Getting hit in melee now shows the red flash and a damage number
Bosses got their own shapes and new attacks: charges with a warning lane, rock/acid strikes with warning circles, summoned guards
New raid result screen: YOU DIED / EXTRACTED with time, kills, XP and the items you lost or secured – deploy again with one click
Zombies: full heal after every wave, new 💉 heal stations, smaller buy spots
Extraction: trader, medic, town and outpost removed – enemies and the military base stay
🤝 Trading: send a trade request to any online player (Arena → Trade)
Offer items from your stash plus scrap and coins, see exactly what the other side gives
Both press Ready and everything swaps at once – any change resets Ready, so no last-second tricks
Items in your loadout are locked while you trade
🧟 Zombies: survive as many waves as you can, alone or with up to 4 players (Play → Zombies)
Zombies, Runners, Spitters, Tanks – and the Abomination every 5th wave
Points for every hit and kill: wall guns, mystery box, Pack-a-Punch (×1.6 damage per level) and four perks
No item loss, fallen players return after the wave, XP for every wave survived
Leaderboard: Zombies best wave
⚔️ PvP arena: create or join 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 lobbies (Play → PvP arena)
Best of 5 rounds on 4 small symmetric maps, no friendly fire
You fight with copies of your loadout – you never lose items in PvP
PvP rating (Elo): win +300 XP, each kill +60 XP; leaving a match counts as a loss
Leaderboard: new PvP rating category
Extraction map is about three times bigger: 48 buildings, 130 crates, 6 extraction zones
Enemies to farm: Scavs, Brutes, Snipers (watch the red laser), Drones – they drop loot and give XP
Military base guarded by Enforcers with 🎖️ military crates (weapons and armor)
Three bosses now: Raccoon King, Iron Golem and Hive Queen (she calls drones)
Town and outpost are safe from enemies: 🏪 trader (buy consumables with scrap, sell your loot) and ⛑️ medic (full heal for 40 scrap)
Cleaner top bar: just the Snake / Arena switch
Arena uses the full page width – cases and shop no longer look like a phone
The raid fits on the screen without scrolling
Snake / Arena switch at the top – the arena is now its own full page
Arena levels: earn XP from kills, bosses, extractions, crates and time in raid
Every level: 2 stat points (HP, defense, carry weight, speed, damage, fire rate, regen, luck) and 1 skill point
Skill tree with 30 skills in Assault, Survival and Tactics – resetting costs a lot of coins and scrap
New Profile tab with your level, record and build; Inventory now holds Equip, List and Salvage
Leaderboard: new Arena level category
💡 Suggest an improvement – button under the patch notes, goes straight to us as a ticket
Leaderboard fix: old records that dropped off (e.g. big Starlight multis) are back
Wins and snake runs that are still in progress during a server update now count
New event: 🥤 Shell Game – follow the stone under 3 cups, 5 rounds, faster each time
Labyrinth: driving into a dead end sends you back to the start
Mystery box Jackpot: +50 length (was +12)
Poker: no more flickering cards, big win banner with coin rain and sounds
Leaderboard: every win counts for Best multi (e.g. Starlight) and Biggest win too
No more default music – Sunny pop is now in the Cosmetic Shop (18,000)
Default music is now Sunny pop: quieter, upbeat, with a beat
Arena: drag & drop items onto weapon, armor, backpack and Q/G slots
Equip tab shows your stash – drag a slot back to take it off
Raid inventory: drag from the backpack onto slots and back
Arena: smoother movement, no more getting stuck on corners
Boss: the Raccoon King roams the map every 2–10 min – kill him for 3 Sovereign-tier drops
Supply drops with gear every 3–6 min, announced 15 s ahead
Crates now only give grenades and heals
Box obstacles removed from the map
Salvage gives less scrap
Free default music for everyone: Sunny jazz
Leaderboard: every run counts, you can hold several spots
New name: Kek-Game, new address game.flashkeks.com
New logo: raccoon with beer and döner
Main menu with Games, Gamba and Kekémon (coming soon)
Cosmetic Shop banner right in the menu, with countdown
Events: fewer coins, three times more length
Salvaging several items always asks first and shows the scrap
ESC always takes you one menu back
Patch notes live here now
Slots: the feed no longer spoils a big win before the reels stop
Arena hub split into Equip, Inventory and Salvage
Equip: click a slot to pick from matching items
Salvage: one click for all Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic
Compact cards (Rare · ⚡ score), details on hover
Backpacks: new slot, 12 to 50 raid slots
Raid inventory in the middle, Apex style
Burning is quiet: just a red edge for the one who burns
Railgun: instant beam through walls, 250 damage
Fat Boy: real mini nuke with mushroom cloud
Singularity: every hit opens a black hole
Glowing tracers from Epic up, rockets, magic orbs, new sounds
Arena: rarity rolled per case, Legendary to Ultra rare
New cases: Mage, Demolition, Sovereign (100k)
Special items from Epic up: Flamethrower, Railgun, Fat Boy …
Effects equally rare on every tier
Two consumable slots (Q/G): nuke, black hole, flashbang, blink …
Armor only from cases and crates
Doors on buildings are visible
Arena: helmet, vest, pants, boots with set bonuses
Grenades, hiding in buildings, bushes and smoke
Slow health regeneration, raid inventory (Tab)
Arena becomes an extraction shooter: loadout, loot crates, extraction zones
Cases, shop, salvage to scrap
Cosmetic Shop: 134 designs, daily and weekly offers
Poker lobbies, Plinko, blackjack side bets
Achievements with titles, stats, leaderboard filters
Map events: Maze, Coin Rush, Last Snake Standing
